title: look_at_cards
description: The sender looks at cards some players do not see: the top cards of a deck (`quantity`, the whole deck by default) or a hand, of any player, e.g. to resolve an effect (Shrewd Yasuki, Agasha Swordsmith, Kitsuki Investigator). The log gives the cards to the sender only (the others read how many cards and where): the sender then resolves the effect with other actions on them (`add_card_to_hand`, `put_card_on_deck`, `shuffle_into_deck`, `discard_card`, `reveal_card`). Nothing is recorded: the cards are out of sight again afterwards.

target_player_id.description: Player whose deck or hand it is.

quantity.description: Number of cards from the top of a deck; the whole stack by default.
